description: Surface Codex lifecycle state in tmux-airline.

hooks.command: cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex SessionStart; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex UserPromptSubmit; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex PermissionRequest; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex PostToolUse; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex Stop; fi
cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex SessionEnd; fi
